style.backgroundSystem: flat single-colour pastel panels (#A9DBF2 / #F7E8C9 / #F8746C) each carrying one rounded white product card #FFFFFF; no photographic scenery, no sky gradient

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium candy-pastel baby-toy ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of #FFFFFF base field, #A9DBF2 and #F7E8C9 secondary panels, #F8746C as the single accent, #2D2D2D for all text; warm-neutral tone; one rounded modern geometric sans-serif family with chunky friendly display headlines and small body labels; background system of flat single-colour panels carrying one rounded white product card; lighting system bright even high-key studio light, soft front-left key, gentle diffuse contact shadow, no hard shadow and no colour cast; layout system with 24px corner-radius cards, staggered two-column infographic blocks, numbered circle badges and short callout labels; icon system thin-line rounded sticker icons with star and sparkle accents used sparingly; product presentation front 3/4 with stable scale, centring and true material finish; no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no photographic sky gradients, no clutter.
style.presentationRules: stable front 3/4 hero angle across the set, consistent product scale and centring, whole product never clipped, true matte plastic material rendering, contact shadow always present
style.surfaceSystem: rounded white card as the default product surface; one natural wood-grain tabletop #D8B98F allowed in the lifestyle scene
style.typography: one rounded modern geometric sans-serif family; chunky friendly display headline 28-40pt, small body labels 10-14pt, Chinese copy wrapped in 「」, per-screen text budget under 50 characters
